subject.title: Feature request: Coalesce interleaved text blocks into single outbound message

question: Should OpenClaw add an opt-in whole-turn delivery policy that coalesces or defers tool-interleaved assistant text, and what should its config shape and owner boundary be?
rationale: The source-backed UX problem is real, but the requested fix adds delivery policy and configuration surface across shared channel behavior, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Add opt-in core coalescing policy
options.body: Define a narrow agents/channel delivery mode that preserves metadata and coalesces text across tool execution with tests for streamed and final payload paths.

options.title: Keep current delivery boundaries
options.body: Leave tool-start and final-payload boundaries visible, and close or defer this request if maintainers do not want another delivery-policy config surface.

options.title: Wait for Discord ordering work
options.body: Resolve the related streaming-off ordering PR first, then revisit whether the remaining notification-spam problem still needs a separate coalescing policy.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in core coalescing policy
recommendation.body: Define a narrow agents/channel delivery mode that preserves metadata and coalesces text across tool execution with tests for streamed and final payload paths.
